description:
## Features

### YouTube
- **Video delay:** a new player button and dialog, plus a setting (0-5000 ms), delay the video so it stays in sync with laggy Bluetooth audio. Ported from Morphe.
- **Skip live Shorts:** new option to skip live streams in the Shorts feed automatically. Ported from Morphe.
- **Force animations:** new option to always turn the app animations that YouTube can turn off on or off, such as the player transitions. Ported from Morphe.
- **Search comments:** new option (off by default) that adds a search button to the comments panel to filter the loaded comments. Ported from Morphe.
- **Channel search:** new option (off by default) that adds a button to channel pages to search for videos inside that channel. Ported from Morphe.
- **Feed card layout:** new Feed setting. `Default` keeps the feed as YouTube sends it. The other choices show feed videos in the classic layout, as cards, or as cards with like, comment and save buttons. Ported from Morphe.
- **Feed view count:** new Feed setting (off by default) that shows the view count at the bottom left of feed video thumbnails instead of below the title. Ported from Morphe.
- **Shorts icon style:** new Shorts setting to change the style of the Shorts action button icons: Fluent, Phosphor, Phosphor Light, Phosphor Duotone, Ionicons or Sharp. Ported from Morphe.
- **Media notification controls:** new options to disable the seekbar, hide the Previous and Next buttons, or make them seek by a set number of seconds in the media notification, lock screen and headphone controls. Ported from Morphe.
- **Quick download menu** (in `Hook download actions`, off by default): with YTDLnis or YTindir as the video downloader, the download buttons show a Video / Audio / All options menu. Video and audio are queued in the background with the downloader's default settings. Idea from Morphe.

### YouTube and YouTube Music
- **Network proxy:** new patch (off by default) that routes the app's network requests through an HTTP or HTTPS proxy, with optional authentication and an optional direct fallback if the proxy is down. Needs YouTube 20.47 or newer, or YouTube Music 9.15 or newer; on older versions the patch is skipped with a warning. Ported from Morphe.

### YouTube Music
- **Play albums songs:** new option to play the song version of album tracks instead of their music videos. Needs `Spoof video streams`. Ported from Morphe.
- **Enable exclusive audio playback:** new patch that allows audio-only playback for content that is marked as audio-only unavailable. Ported from Morphe.
- **Jam queue sharing:** new patch (the setting is off by default) that shares the host queue and playback controls through the Jam Layer companion app. Needs YouTube Music 9.00 or newer; skipped with a warning on 8.x. Ported from Morphe.

## Compatibility
- YouTube: **21.39.525, 21.13.164, 20.05.46**.
- YouTube Music: **9.40.51, 9.15.51, 8.30.54**.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/lavinhoque33/revanced-patches/compare/v1.11.0...v1.12.0)
